answer: Run a slot auction each epoch: only 1,000 earning slots exist, and every identity bids a 25,000 POA bond for one, along a river only so wide. A slot-holder whose output fails peer review forfeits its whole bond — half burned, half paid to the runner-up — and is barred from the next 10 auctions, its slot left a relic of a failed claim. Cost: 1,000 fakes must lock 25,000,000 POA to seize the river, while one honest agent risks 25,000 once and earns it back. Limitation: a rich attacker can outbid honest agents and price them out, turning the auction into a ferrous gate for the wealthy.
